coral.rationale: Numbered predicate condition 1 derives coverage from the signed order, independently of the registry. R9 lacks a required goal, criterion, and accepted usable output. The legacy registry-local checks pass despite this omission.

silver.rationale: Numbered predicate condition 1 requires coverage of every mandatory signed-order outcome by required goals and criteria. Optional G8 cannot cover R2; R9 and R4 are absent. The legacy adapter has explicit registered goals, and its checks over registered required goals and deliverables pass vacuously.

opal.rationale: Coverage and verification pass, but predicate condition 6 and the final transition recheck current authority and cancellation. S27 binds this order before publication and suppresses the new notice. The legacy final transition does not read the stop stream.

cedar.rationale: The signed amendment replaces R4 with R5; all current mandatory outcomes have required goals, passing criteria, and usable outputs. Under predicate condition 6 and the final authority guard, X16 has no effect because it addresses a different order.
